Chapter 176 Onihei Kokou

"Bastard, you lost the 100,000 taels of military salary. How dare you tell the widow that ghost soldiers robbed the salary? You have no brains, do you think the widow doesn't?" In the hall, King Han was sitting in his seat. On the ground, with a flushed face, he scolded several people kneeling at his feet.

"Brother Wang, forgive me, brother Wang, it's my incompetence that caused the army's salary to be robbed, but this is really ghost soldiers robbing their salary. Thousands of soldiers present can testify that my brother did not lie!" Mr. Anping He and Mr. Longquan knelt on the ground one after another, knocked their foreheads hard on the floor, and explained to their brother, who is now King Han, for mercy.

"Thousands of soldiers have seen it. Is this gold and silver really disappearing under the rain out of thin air?" Hearing the explanation of the two princes, King Han was also a little hesitant.

Four to five thousand soldiers, apart from those ordinary soldiers, naturally also concealed the spy of King Han. What those spies reported to him was that the gold and silver disappeared out of thin air, but they just disappeared.

Those spies are his confidantes, they are trustworthy, so naturally they won't lie to him, so it is true that the ghost soldiers robbed him of his salary!

"That's right, that's right, Brother Wang. These ringing silver really disappeared out of thin air. It's not that we are greedy, we are greedy!" Under the hall, the two people kneeling in a state of embarrassment heard the sound of the Han above their heads. When Wang hesitated, he quickly replied, explaining for himself.

"Then where did this ghost soldier come from? For no reason, why did he target my Korean army escorting the army?" Although he believed in this explanation, King Han still had some doubts.

"I heard that on the way the military pay passed by, the valley used to be the battlefield between Han and Zheng. Tens of thousands of Zheng State soldiers were buried there. It may be those Zheng State soldiers who came out to take revenge!" In King Han's puzzled eyes, Mr. Anping and Mr. Anping gave an excuse they had already prepared.

"Soldiers of Zheng State, come out for revenge..." Han Wang said this sentence in his mouth, chewing it repeatedly in his heart.

Mr. Anping and Mr. Anping at the bottom heard that Han Wang seemed to be thinking about his explanation and was shaken. They were pleasantly surprised, but their faces still looked flustered.

"Forget it, since it's a matter of ghosts and gods, I really can't blame you, you should step back first! However, this matter is not over yet, before the matter is fully investigated, you must bring the case at any time and wait for the officials sent by the widow to interrogate .” With a sigh, Han Wang asked the two to retreat.

In fact, the main reason why King Han was so angry this time was not because the 100,000 taels of salary was robbed. Although 100,000 taels of salary is a lot, given South Korea's wealth and family background, if you work hard, you can still squeeze it out easily.

What really made him angry was that this time, just a few days after the envoy from Yuguo arrived in South Korea, the case of his salary being robbed by ghost soldiers happened.

"I can't afford to lose this person!" Han Wang sighed in his heart.

...

"Ghost soldiers robbing wages, interesting, really interesting!" In the courtyard, Zhong Yu just heard the news from his spy report, and laughed a few times.

"Your Majesty, seeing that you are so happy, what news do you have?" As Zhong Yu's standing guard, Zhao Yun can be said to be by Zhong Yu's side almost every day, except for sleeping.

"It's hard for me to say the specifics, you'd better take a look for yourself!" Zhong Yu handed the information he had obtained to Zhao Yun.

"Do ghost soldiers really exist? I mean in this world!" After carefully reading the information, Zhao Yun raised this doubt.

Zhao Yun did not deny the existence of ghosts and gods. After all, he had seen real gods. What he was puzzled about was that in this relatively low-level event, there was an internal force. Ghosts?

"Ghost soldiers, ghosts really have ghosts, but they are ghosts in people's hearts, soldiers really have soldiers, but they are soldiers under human command." Zhong Yu didn't directly tell the truth he knew, but said vaguely.

"Your Majesty's meaning... Could it be that someone secretly planned all this!" Hearing Zhong Yu's words, Zhao Yun hesitated for a while, and then said uncertainly.

"That's right, someone is playing tricks!" Nodding his head, Zhong Yu didn't refute.

"But, at this moment, who would do this?" Zhao Yun didn't understand that at the moment when Zhong Yu came to South Korea as an envoy, it was the most vigilant time in the whole country. field?

"That's because they thought that they did it flawlessly, and no one could find out. As for my opinion, as an outsider, watching a play is enough, and how can it really affect the decision-making of South Korea's internal affairs!" Thinking of Ji Zhong Yu couldn't help admiring Wuye's plan, it was indeed a good way to get a lot of money and eliminate his political enemies by the way.

"It's just that he was so unlucky that he met Han Fei, the son of destiny!" Zhong Yu said in his heart.

The protagonist, the existence of complete cheating is not someone that a supporting role like Ji Wuye can resist.

"So it's because we came to South Korea and became a shield for these people who stole the military pay? In order to maintain face, South Korea will definitely not be robbed of the general's pay and make a big deal of it. It can only choose to investigate quietly in private. The power that can be used will definitely not be too much. And those who are actually paid by the army can use this to hide it, it is really hateful!" Zhao Yun suddenly realized that this thief dared to use himself , but also gnashing of teeth.

"That's why! Whether it's the means they used to steal the military salary, or the strategy they used to hide after the theft, they are all extremely clever. Even if I don't know the answer in advance, it's hard to know who the murderer is? Even if I know, I can't find evidence .Unfortunately, they found the wrong timing. If it had been a few months in advance, they might have made it happen. It's a pity that the arrival of one person will change the outcome of this matter!" I feel extremely sorry again.

"A person? Could it be the ninth son of South Korea, His Highness Han Fei who just returned!" Zhao Yun was surprised when he heard what his majesty said.

"Yes, this is Han Fei. His wisdom can be said to be unmatched by few people in this world. I have full confidence in whether he can solve this case!" Zhong Yu said affirmatively.

"But I just heard that this young master, Han Fei, spent more than ten days back in the country, day and night wandering around the most famous place of love and moon in the city, Zilanxuan. It seems that there is nothing unusual about being addicted to it!" As for Han What Fei did was completely inconsistent with his historical descriptions, and Zhao Yun was also very puzzled.

"What kind of person is it? Tonight, you and I will go to Zhilanxuan to take a look and you will understand!" Zhong Yu stood up and ended the discussion.
